title: US to ban some Canadian alcohol, dairy and motorbike imports

note: Nigeria's government and Boko Haram have reportedly reached a secret three-month ceasefire, following the release of 360 villagers abducted in an earlier attack. The unconfirmed truce would mark a rare pause in an insurgency that has displaced millions in the northeast.

title: UN sees gradual return after CAR border attack displaces 17,000
note: A UN stabilization mission reports gradual signs of normal life returning to Am-Dafock in the Central African Republic, near the Sudan border, after an armed group attack killed 29 people and displaced more than 17,000. Increased patrols have helped over 5,000 people return home.
